title: scNoiseMeter: barcode-aware alignment artifact and read-distribution QC for single-cell RNA-seq
description: scNoiseMeter classifies mapped primary RNA-seq alignments, partitions aligned bases, and reports per-sample, per-cell, per-cluster, and plate-level alignment composition and artifact-candidate evidence. It supports ONT, PacBio/Kinnex, short-read droplet data, and Smart-seq/FLASH-seq plates without presenting non-canonical alignment fractions as causal contamination estimates.
